name: Accountability
about: How NCRI-Ghana answers to communities, partners and supporters for its decisions, spending and results.

name: Anti-fraud & Anti-corruption
about: Zero tolerance for fraud, bribery and the misuse of resources, with clear steps for prevention, detection and response.

name: Complaints & Whistleblowing
about: Safe, confidential ways for anyone to raise a concern or complaint, and protection for those who speak up.

name: Conflict of Interest
about: How directors, staff, volunteers and partners declare and manage personal or financial interests.

name: Financial Management
about: Budgeting, controls, record-keeping and reporting so funds are used well and can be traced.

name: Procurement
about: Fair, open and value-for-money buying of goods and services, with documented selection of suppliers.

name: Child Safeguarding & Protection
about: Preventing and responding to abuse, exploitation, neglect and other harm to children.

name: Gender Equality & Inclusion
about: Promoting equality, dignity, meaningful participation and protection from discrimination and gender-based violence.

name: Data Protection & Records
about: Protecting personal information, confidential records and sensitive safeguarding data.
